articles.title: Bitcoin risk management grows more popular as the 'just bet on price' era fades
UK financial watchdog opens consultations for DeFi guidance, crypto laws
articles.snippet: The UK Financial Conduct Authority consultations came just weeks after the agency opened applications for companies under its new crypto regulatory regime.

articles.title: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs Join Growing List of Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
articles.snippet: Sixteen companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, up from nine just four days earlier, according to an updated public notice.
